column4: dialect-gated: a single flat CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL gate via testutil.TestDB(t, DialectMSSQL), no subtest split, so it costs one skip in this PostgreSQL-only job -- same shape as the sibling TestRunDownMigrationsDropsMSSQLSecurityPolicyBeforeTheTable line in this same file group. Guards cleat#2850 (PR #2859) on the dialect cleat#2822's Version 8 actually hit: a two-statement DownMSSQL whose second statement fails must roll back the first, since SQL Server supports transactional DDL. Only test-go/support carries a line for the same reason as the sibling: ./plugin/... is in that package group and the cluster job runs ./engine/... only, not this package. Measured by name: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL go test ./plugin/ -run TestRunDownMigrationsRollsBackAPartiallyFailedMultiStatementDownOnMSSQL -count=1 -json | grep -c '"Action":"skip"' reports exactly one.
